subject.title: Add persistent cron job execution history with filtering

question: Which cron history product surface should core support beyond the existing SQLite cron.runs path, and what redaction, access, and retention rules must apply before adding CLI export, follow, time-range, and summary behavior?
rationale: The remaining request changes public CLI, protocol, config, retention, and potentially sensitive audit-history behavior, so automation should not choose the durable history contract or security policy alone.

options.title: Narrow cron.runs expansion
options.body: Add timestamp filters and a focused CLI/docs surface on the existing SQLite reader, then defer or separately decide export, follow, aggregates, and manual prune behavior.

options.title: Full audit-history suite
options.body: Implement logs/history CLI, export/follow, success-rate summaries, and retention/prune commands together after a larger security and UX design pass.

options.title: Retain current scope
options.body: Document existing cron.runs and cron.runLog.keepLines behavior as the supported surface and narrow or close the remaining feature request.

recommendation.title: Narrow cron.runs expansion
recommendation.body: Add timestamp filters and a focused CLI/docs surface on the existing SQLite reader, then defer or separately decide export, follow, aggregates, and manual prune behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest combined signal from original cron run-history history and prior public review context on this issue.
